_comment: Provenance of the vendored OpenAPI document (R-GEN-2), resolving the spec's open
'Provenance encoding' question in favour of a sibling file: the schema stays
byte-identical to the published release asset, so its sha256 keeps verifying, and the
verify task reads this without parsing 3.5 MB of JSON.
The three version strings below are deliberately separate and none is derivable from
another (R-VER-1). 'releaseTag' is the GitHub release; 'apiVersion' is the backend
application version reported as info.version and /api/health.version; the URL major
'/api/v1' is a third axis entirely. Tag v0.2.0 ships apiVersion 1.0.0 — reading a
compatibility floor off the tag would gate against the wrong number.
Bump all fields here in the same commit that replaces openapi.json (R-GEN-6).
